decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a publicly renamed and further developed version of an established trommel screen with a loyal customer base, so dropping it would write off the visible upgrade investment and expose the renaming as a mistake.
The AK series is a multi-model mobile shredder line that was publicly re-engineered to EU Stage V emissions and presented at a trade fair, a large and visible commitment that management would defend.

The grinder line was given more prominence in 2019 with its own page, and as a multi-model mobile line central to the firm's mobile business, any weak results can still be attributed to temporary market conditions.

The firm publicly claimed the new CERON generation sets standards in stationary single-shaft pre-shredders and cited it in reference installations, so it is too central and visible a commitment to abandon.
